klipler.istem: The gecko walks slowly across the ceiling upside down, lifting and placing one foot at a time, toes spreading flat on the ceiling, the lamp glows. Static camera from below. The gecko keeps four legs, five toes per foot and the same shape. 3D animation style preserved.

The gecko on the glass slowly lifts one front foot, the toes peel off the glass from the tips backward, then it presses the foot back flat onto the glass. Slow push-in. The gecko keeps four legs and five toes per foot. 3D animation style preserved.
Slow dramatic camera glide across the ridged toe pads, light sweeps across the fine plates making them glisten. Static subject. 3D animation style preserved.
Fast zoom deeper into the forest of tiny bristles, the bristles sway gently as if in a soft current, glowing rim light. 3D science animation style preserved.
The bristle slowly lowers and its hundreds of tiny tips touch the glass surface, small soft lights spark where each tip touches, spreading outward. 3D science animation style preserved.
The gecko on the ceiling turns its head toward the viewer, then starts walking upside down along the ceiling. Static camera. Four legs, five toes per foot, same shape. 3D animation style preserved.
